The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

Regarding the themes in the provided text, both excerpts deal with the concept of the American experience and individual aspiration, but they differ significantly in tone and resolution. The text on *The Great Gatsby* presents a pessimistic view, emphasizing the "hollowness" of the American Dream and framing Gatsby's life as tragic. In contrast, the text on *Invisible Man* offers an optimistic perspective, focusing on "self-discovery and affirmation" despite societal challenges. The similarity lies in their engagement with the broader American narrative and the struggles of the individual within it; the difference is in the outcome: one concludes in tragedy and disillusionment, while the other concludes in resilience and self-affirmation.
